header.title: Featured Projects
header.description: A collection of aerospace engineering projects demonstrating experience in aircraft structures, propulsion, computational analysis, and aerospace system design.

projects.title: Digital Twin of an Aircraft Wing
projects.description: Developed a scale-down digital twin of an aircraft wing by integrating strain gauges, a load cell, and an accelerometer with an ESP32 for real-time structural monitoring. Validated the wing through finite element analysis, CFD, ground vibration testing, bending tests, and temperature dispersion studies while visualizing live sensor data on a monitoring dashboard.

projects.title: CFD Analysis of a Pintle Injector
projects.description: Performed CFD simulations in ANSYS Fluent to study the effect of varying pintle gaps on flow characteristics of a liquid rocket engine injector. Compared injector performance for multiple pintle gap configurations while maintaining a constant pintle angle to analyse velocity distribution and flow behaviour.

projects.title: Cold Flow Analysis of a Convergent-Divergent Nozzle
projects.description: Analysed compressible flow through a convergent-divergent nozzle using ANSYS Fluent. Evaluated pressure, temperature, velocity, and Mach number distributions and compared numerical results with theoretical gas dynamic relations.

projects.title: Solid Rocket Motor Performance Analysis
projects.description: Performed preliminary performance analysis of a solid rocket motor using NASA CEA. Estimated combustion properties, thrust performance, and nozzle characteristics to understand propulsion system behaviour under varying operating conditions.

projects.title: Miniature Auto-Throttle & Thrust Reversal System
projects.description: Designed and developed a miniature aircraft auto-throttle and thrust reversal system using Arduino, servo motors, and a gyroscope sensor. Built a functional prototype with 3D-printed mechanical components to demonstrate automated throttle control concepts.

projects.title: Parachute Design & Recovery System
projects.description: Designed a recovery parachute for a rocket payload by determining parachute dimensions, descent rate, and aerodynamic performance using analytical calculations and engineering design methods.

projects.title: Preliminary Rocket Design
projects.description: Designed a high-power rocket for a 1 km target altitude using SolidWorks and RockSim. Performed preliminary sizing, stability analysis, centre of gravity and centre of pressure evaluation, fin design, and trajectory simulation.
